posts.author: jsfilmz0412
posts.text:
My Final Verdict. Seedance 2.0 Fast vs Gemini Omni Flash.

Gemini Omni Flash just doesn't have a place in my workflow.

Beyond the frustrating 10-second limit and heavy censorship flags, the style transfers completely break character consistency—with the likeness drifting hard and even changing my characters' race to Caucasian. 

The only real positive here is that generation speed is fast.

Fingers crossed for what Google does next with Veo 4. 

Yeah, I understand going against the grain probably means my work won’t get featured by Google or pushed by the people who want everything to sound positive.

But I’ve always chosen integrity over access or boost.

If something works, I’ll say it works. If something breaks, I’ll show that too. I’d rather be honest with the people watching than pretend everything is perfect just to stay in good standing with big tech. 

Full verdict in the reply👇

posts.text:
Raw power. Real punches. No choreography.

created with Gemini Omni Flash on @muvi_ai 

Prompt:

Ultra-realistic 10-second boxing fight between two women inside a small underground gym. Both fighters look naturally athletic with realistic skin texture, sweat, bruises, and detailed facial expressions. One woman wears black boxing shorts and red gloves, the other wears dark gray sportswear with blue gloves. The fight feels raw and authentic, like real professional sparring footage.

The camera moves handheld around the ring at close range, capturing fast punches, defensive movement, realistic footwork, and heavy breathing. Sweat sprays naturally through the air after impacts. The women exchange quick combinations, dodge punches, and aggressively counterattack with believable body movement and physical weight.

Dim overhead gym lights create realistic shadows on their faces and bodies. The background contains trainers, gym equipment, ropes, mirrors, and a few spectators reacting naturally. No slow motion, no dramatic movie effects, no exaggerated choreography. Everything feels like genuine live fight footage recorded on a high-end cinema camera. Realistic motion blur, natural skin detail, subtle camera shake, grounded physics, authentic combat energy, ultra realistic documentary-style sports cinematography.

posts.author: zarairahh
posts.text:
Collecting sunsets, skylines & little pieces of the world with Muvi Video 

Made with Gemini Omni Flash on @muvi_ai 

Prompt:

Create a 10-second cinematic hyper-lapse selfie travel video of the uploaded female character across 20 world-famous destinations in 2026. Hard cuts every 0.5 seconds synced to the beat. Handheld selfie-stick camera, wide-angle lens, close selfie framing, energetic travel-vlogger style, vibrant cinematic colors, realistic lighting, dynamic motion blur, natural crowds, and clear landmarks in every shot.

Character: cheerful woman in her mid-30s with long soft wavy hair, round glasses, expressive friendly face, and a wristwatch always on her left wrist. Personality is playful, confident, funny, charismatic, upbeat, and energetic.

Strict identity consistency across all scenes: same face, same age, same hairstyle, same glasses, same body proportions, same cheerful personality. No face morphing, gender changes, hairstyle changes, missing glasses, watch switching wrists, or outfit blending.

Locations include: Eiffel Tower Paris, Shibuya Tokyo, Times Square NYC, Colosseum Rome, Pyramids Egypt, Christ the Redeemer Rio, Big Ben London, Sydney Opera House, Grand Palace Bangkok, Taj Mahal, Great Wall China, Burj Khalifa Dubai, Hagia Sophia Istanbul, Venice Grand Canal, Machu Picchu Peru, Acropolis Athens, Sagrada Familia Barcelona, Amsterdam Windmills, Gyeongbokgung Palace Seoul, and Marina Bay Sands Singapore.

Each location features a unique stylish outfit matching the local vibe and a fun expressive pose like waving, peace sign, namaste, finger heart, laughing, pointing at landmarks, thumbs-up, or playful reactions.

Negative prompt: identity change, different ethnicity, younger or older face, blurry face, distorted hands, extra fingers, bad anatomy, low resolution, uncanny smile, missing watch, watch on right wrist, invisible landmarks, duplicate locations, outfit mixing, plastic skin, random people replacing the character.

Google I/O: Is Gemini Omni about to be revealed?

If the video Sundar Pichai showed us was generated from a single prompt, then the new model might already be showing some insane capabilities:

> Seamless style transfer - instant, smooth transitions from realistic video into completely different styles (here it shifts from realism through a glitch effect straight into a black-and-white pencil sketch)
> Character consistency - the faces, clothing, poses, and overall appearance of Sundar Pichai and Demis Hassabis stay perfectly consistent even under heavy stylization
> Temporal coherence - the movement on the stairs stays incredibly smooth and physically accurate, with no weird warping or flickering, even in sketch mode
> Creative effects & transitions - glitches, color streaks, floating triangles, and artistic transitions appear to be generated directly by the model as part of the video itself
> Video-to-video editing - you can take a normal realistic video and transform it into a fully artistic sequence with a single prompt while preserving all motion

And there’s a good chance we’re about to see a brand new Gemini model unveiled
